name: The Game Master
source:
The masked mastermind behind the death game. He calls himself the Unchosen One and believes some sins lie beyond the reach of the law. To him this is not murder but justice.
So why has he gathered these people again?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.gamedeath&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
